title: Ticagrelor vs clopidogrel for major adverse cardiovascular events in acute coronary syndrome
question: In adults with acute coronary syndrome, does ticagrelor reduce major adverse cardiovascular events, defined as the composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke, compared with clopidogrel?
eligibility_summary: Double-blind randomized controlled trials in adults with acute coronary syndrome, NSTE-ACS, or STEMI, with ticagrelor/AZD6140 versus clopidogrel. Eligibility is P/I/C/design only; exact MACE reporting is handled during extraction.
